eurohpc-incident-protocol.title: Europe's supercomputers

eurohpc-incident-protocol.concern: Stop one machine, and innocent users go dark too.
eurohpc-incident-protocol.question: One practice drill, or one shared emergency plan?

jp-procurement-safety-evidence.title: Japan buys AI
jp-procurement-safety-evidence.about: Japan checks AI before buying it. Make safety part of that check.

jp-procurement-safety-evidence.concern: Sellers swap the AI underneath. Your test goes stale.
jp-procurement-safety-evidence.question: Test one version, or a shared buying checklist?
jp-procurement-safety-evidence.complication: Seller swapped the AI. Old test still looks perfect.

sg-agent-data-leakage-deployment-gate.title: Singapore's AI helper
sg-agent-data-leakage-deployment-gate.about: Singapore buys AI helpers. Test whether one leaks private records.

sg-agent-data-leakage-deployment-gate.question: Surprise leak test, or a shared permission check?

sg-kr-jp-shared-eval-evidence-protocol.about: Singapore and Korea tested AI together. Their setups differed.

sg-kr-jp-shared-eval-evidence-protocol.concern: One hidden setting can change everything.

sg-kr-jp-shared-eval-evidence-protocol.complication: A hidden tool setting changed the result.

canada-cohere-equity-safety-covenant.title: Canada's AI investment

canada-cohere-equity-safety-covenant.question: Find one payment still open, or a shared safety promise?

taiwan-public-compute-safety-conditions.title: Taiwan lends computers
taiwan-public-compute-safety-conditions.about: Taiwan lends powerful computers to AI builders. Add a safety check first.

taiwan-public-compute-safety-conditions.question: Test before one release, or rules for every loan?

anthropic-new-credit-lender-safety-coven.title: The lenders
anthropic-new-credit-lender-safety-coven.about: An AI firm's loan has rules. A new loan could add one.

anthropic-new-credit-lender-safety-coven.question: Find one new loan, or a joint bank plan?

lumi-belgium-safety-appendix.title: Belgium's computer time
lumi-belgium-safety-appendix.about: Belgium hands out time on a shared supercomputer. Attach a safety rule.

lumi-eurohpc-evaluation-access.title: Letting testers in
lumi-eurohpc-evaluation-access.about: Safety testers need to see enough of an AI to check it.

lumi-national-evidence-protocol.title: 11 countries, 1 supercomputer

ch-electricity-operator-fallback.title: Switzerland's power grid
ch-electricity-operator-fallback.about: Swissgrid runs its own grid AI. Practise a human takeover.

ch-electricity-operator-fallback.concern: Keep the test small and known.
ch-electricity-operator-fallback.question: Practise a human takeover, or a shared backup plan?

uk-energy-staged-autonomy-assurance.title: UK energy, step by step

uk-agent-accountability-evidence.title: UK: who stops the AI?

sg-purchaser-sandbox-release-gate.title: Singapore: fail means stop?

sg-purchaser-sandbox-release-gate.concern: An approved tester is not a safety promise.

kr-safety-case-incident-rehearsal.title: Korea's new AI law

nigeria-ai-compliance-audit-annex.title: Nigeria's audit
nigeria-ai-compliance-audit-annex.about: Nigeria already audits data use. Would extra AI questions catch more?

rwanda-ai-dpia-security-retest.title: Rwanda's data law
